verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Issuing is an API product. The docs reference endpoints such as /paymentInstruments/{id}, but nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found 404s at all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.adyen.com. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit here.
